Cart saved in the customer's browser

Adding, editing and removing products every month

base.para: Your own place online, ready in 1 or 2 days.
base.bajada: A website that works for you: it introduces you, gets you found and sends every visitor to your WhatsApp.
puntos: An address that's yours, like yourbusiness.com.ar. Your brand stops depending on a social network and gets a place nobody can switch off.
Ready in one or two days
Custom design, built for phones and computers, no templates. While others wait weeks, you're already online.
Easy to find on Google and in AI
Titles, description, structured data and speed tuned for search engines (SEO) and for assistants like ChatGPT or Gemini (GEO).
Domain, hosting, security certificate and the first month of changes included. After that, each tweak is quoted separately.
base.entrega: Same day or, at most, within two business days.

emprendedor.para: Your storefront open 24/7, with orders sent to your WhatsApp.
emprendedor.bajada: Shopping today happens on the phone. Your catalog, organized and always open, turns every visit into an order.
puntos: Your products by category, with photos, prices and variants like size or color. Found in seconds, at any hour.
Your customer picks, the cart adds it up and the order lands on your WhatsApp ready to go. You confirm and close the sale your way, with no per-sale fees.
Products that show up when people search
Every product with a name, description and structured data so Google and AI assistants show it to whoever is looking.
Every month I add, edit and mark items as sold out. Promos and seasons without you touching a single line of code.
emprendedor.entrega: About ten business days, depending on the number of products.

servicios.para: Your services on display and your schedule up to date.
servicios.bajada: Your calendar keeps working while you're with a client: your customers pick a day and time right on your website.
puntos: Each service with its price, duration and photos. Your customer arrives knowing what they want and what it costs.
They book by day and time from their phone, even outside your business hours.
So people nearby can find you
Local SEO so you show up when someone searches for your service in your city, on Google, on Maps and in AI assistants.
A dashboard to view and manage appointments, with WhatsApp reminders so nobody forgets.
